description: A 28-item physician knowledge questionnaire developed by Rahav Koren Roni et al.
title: AABB-guideline-based transfusion medicine knowledge questionnaire

description: A state-oriented survey instrument developed by the American Association of Colleges for Teacher Education and Westat to collect information about beginning teachers’ classroom experiences, performance, and needs for educator-preparation program improvement and cross-program comparisons.
title: AACTE and Westat pilot survey of beginning teachers and their supervisors

description: A 15-question multiple-choice endodontic diagnostic assessment developed by Durmazpinar Parla Meva and colleagues at Marmara University using consented real patient cases, radiographs, clinical photographs, and patient histories aligned with American Association of Endodontists guidelines.
title: AAE-guideline-based 15-question endodontic diagnostic assessment with radiographs, clinical photographs and patient histories

description: A 33-item Likert-style instrument developed by Andrew Mason and colleagues to measure students' attitudes and approaches to physics problem solving, including diagram use, reflection, persistence, and representational preferences.
title: AAPS survey

description: A curriculum-planning framework published by the American Association of Physics Teachers that organizes undergraduate physics laboratory learning goals into six areas: modeling, experimental design, technical and practical skills, knowledge construction, data analysis and visualization, and physics
title: AAPT six-area taxonomy of learning goals for the undergraduate physics lab curriculum

description: A set of named family-caregiving educational resource collections produced by AARP, the American Journal of Nursing, and the National League for Nursing for integration into nursing education.
title: AARP Family Caregiving How-To Video Series, AJN caregiver content, and NLN ACE.C materials

description: AARP Foundation Experience Corps is a volunteer-based literacy tutoring programme run by AARP Foundation in which trained adults aged 50 and older tutor struggling K–3 readers individually or in small groups.
title: AARP Foundation Experience Corps

description: The AI-Augmented Software Engineering Education framework, proposed by Qusay H.
title: AASEE framework

description: The American Association of Variable Star Observers (AAVSO) archival database is a freely disseminated collection of more than 33 million variable-star observations for scientific research and education.
title: AAVSO archival database of over 33 million variable-star observations
